items.title: The Stocks That Got Hit Hardest This Week
items.summary: Tech stocks wrapped up the week with gains, but it has still been a very tough five days.

items.title: Axon Just Bet $1.2 Billion That Drones Will Be the New First Responders
items.summary: Axon buried its biggest bet ever inside an earnings release that missed estimates and trimmed guidance, and Wall Street sent the stock sliding. Was the market punishing a stumble, or overlooking the move that shapes what comes next?

items.title: Axon Enterprise earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Axon Enterprise (AXON) is $312.79, down 18.24% as of Nov 6, 12:51 PM EST. That is a fresh 52-week low area (range $307.00–$665.07), and the market cap is about $25.3B. The Nasdaq rose 1.7% the same day, so this is a company-specific reaction.

items.title: Axon Stock Plunges as Delayed Drone Deals Hit Revenue
items.summary: Delays in federal drone contracts force Axon Enterprise to lower its annual revenue outlook.

items.title: Axon Sinks 17% on Revenue Miss, Guidance Cut and $1.2 Billion Skydio Bet on “Millions of Drones”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAxon shares fell 17% after third-quarter revenue of $909 million missed estimates and the company cut its 2026 growth outlook to about 30%. About $130 million of delayed federal Dedrone deployments drove the cut, while software and services revenue grew 43%, so this looks like timing.

items.title: AXON Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Federal Delays and AI Growth
items.summary: Axon cuts its 2026 revenue outlook amid federal counter-drone delays, even as AI adoption, software growth and a $1.2 billion Skydio investment fuel expansion.

items.title: Axon Enterprise Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates as Margins Narrow
items.summary: AXON's Q3 earnings and revenues miss estimates as margin pressures and delayed federal counter-drone projects prompt a cut to its 2026 sales outlook.

items.title: Axon Stock Falls as Federal Drone Deployments Stall
items.summary: Full-year growth guidance drops to about 30% after three federal Dedrone deployments were delayed
